results.content: A new Emerson College Polling survey of likely 2026 voters finds the Democrats with an 11-point advantage over the Republicans on the generic congressional ballot, leading 53% to 42%. President Trump holds a 39% job approval rating, consistent with the past two months, whereas his disapproval increased another point, to 57%. [...] On the Republican ballot test, voters remain split between Vice President JD Vance (39%) and Secretary of State Marco Rubio (38%). Five percent support Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and Donald Trump Jr. respectively, while 9% are undecided. [...] Voters are more concerned (63%) rather than excited (14%) about artificial intelligence, while 22% are neither concerned
results.title: July 2026 National Poll: Democrats with 11-Point Generic Ballot Advantage

results.content:
The Emerson College Polling survey, conducted July 19-20 among 1,100 likely 2026 voters, with a plus or minus 2.9 percent margin of error, found Democrats leading Republicans by 53 percent to 42 percent on the generic congressional ballot.

In the same poll, President Donald Trump’s approval rating stood at 39 percent, while his disapproval rating was 57 percent, giving a net approval rating (those who approve minus those who disapprove) of -18.
